question: Which of the following was a key feature of financial sector reforms under NEP 1991?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Establishment of private sector banks**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The financial sector reforms under NEP 1991 emphasized **liberalization, privatization, and globalization** to improve the efficiency and competitiveness of India's financial system.
